messages:
Maria (AcmeHealth): Hey team — invoice INV-2026-045 shows ~27% more tokens than the dashboard for 2026-03-13. Dashboard shows 1,200,345 tokens, invoice shows 1,526,789. Our accounting flagged this, can you help reconcile?
Sam (Support): Thanks @Maria. Can you confirm invoice id (looks like INV-2026-045) and paste a few sample request_ids or timestamps? Also which timezone does your finance team use?
Maria (AcmeHealth): Invoice: INV-2026-045. Sample request ids: req_8a1, req_8a2, req_9b3 (timestamps attached). Our finance uses US/Eastern (EST).
Sam (Support): Ping @Lex (Finance) and @Anna (Engineering). billing-bot, any logs for that invoice run?
billing-bot (system): Invoice job for 2026-03-13 completed at 2026-03-14T00:00:02Z. Aggregation window: start=2026-03-13T00:00:00-08:00 end=2026-03-14T00:00:00-08:00 (America/Los_Angeles). File: s3://billing/invoices/INV-2026-045.json
Anna (Engineering): Looking now. Initial hypothesis: DST transition on 2026-03-13 changed local day length (spring-forward) and our invoice aggregation code normalizes to local midnight but then applies UTC offsets incorrectly, producing a 1-hour overlap with the prior day's window. I'll compute hourly buckets to confirm.
Anna (Engineering): Quick log snippet from aggregator: ```agg_window = [2026-03-13T08:00:00Z, 2026-03-14T08:00:00Z]  # expected [2026-03-13T07:00:00Z,2026-03-14T07:00:00Z]``` That extra hour accounts for ~326,444 tokens — matches delta.
Lex (Finance): If confirmed, we should issue a provisional credit equal to the delta immediately. Need the token delta and amount so I can create the credit and a revrec note for accounting.
Sam (Support): Maria: we'll issue a provisional credit now and follow up with a permanent adjustment after reconciliation. @Anna can you confirm whether dedupe would have prevented this?
Anna (Engineering): Confirmed token delta = 326,444 tokens. Dedupe did not trigger because the aggregator produced overlapping time ranges; events in the overlap were included twice (previous day's events remained in storage and were re-aggregated). Fix is a timezone-normalization patch; deploying now.
Anna (Engineering): Deploy complete at 2026-03-14T15:24:00Z (commit abc1234). Patch ensures aggregation windows use fixed UTC boundaries, not local DST-shifting boundaries.
Lex (Finance): Provisional credit created: CREDIT-2026-789 for $1,305.60 (rate $0.004/token * 326,444). RevRec note: "Provisional credit issued due to billing aggregation overlap caused by DST transition in America/Los_Angeles timezone; pending final reconciliation. Reference INV-2026-045."
Sam (Support): Maria — provisional credit CREDIT-2026-789 has been posted to your account. You should see adjustment on your next statement; finance also emailed your accounting contact. Sorry for the hassle. :pray:
Maria (AcmeHealth): Thanks — that helps. Please include the revrec text for our auditors as well.
Lex (Finance): Done — revrec text attached to invoice record and emailed to accounting@acmehealth. References: INV-2026-045, CREDIT-2026-789.
Sam (Support): I'll mark this thread resolved once you confirm accounting received the email.
Maria (AcmeHealth): Confirmed receipt from accounting. Closing from our side, thanks everyone! :tada:
